title: parkour_boyfriend_deleted_my_world
display_title: My boyfriend deleted my Minecraft world because I beat his parkour time.
beats: My boyfriend (31M) deleted my Minecraft world because I beat his parkour time by 0.3 seconds.
I'm (28F) three years into a survival world with a build he's mocked as 'blocky' since day one.
He said it was 'just pixels' and I was 'too competitive for a couple's game night.'
I backed up nothing, and now I'm rebuilding from a two-month-old world file while he sleeps on the couch.
His mom says I should let it go since it's 'not real,' my sister says block him from the console entirely.
So, Reddit... AITAH for changing the wifi password until he replaces my world?
